activity.notes: Morgan is first explicitly recorded commanding a ship in the 1666 privateering expedition and was subsequently elected admiral of the buccaneers. His English-authorized Caribbean privateering culminated in the Panama expedition of 1670–1671.

sources.title: Dictionary of National Biography, 1885–1900 — Morgan, Henry
sources.citation_text: Records Morgan commanding a ship in 1666, his election as admiral of the buccaneers, and later commissioned expeditions from Jamaica.

sources.title: The Jamaica discipline and the epochal nature of English Atlantic privateering and piracy, 1660–1726
sources.citation_text: Cites the 1670 commission and instructions issued to Admiral Henry Morgan and his 1671 account of the Panama expedition.
